card.line: Pi-hahiroth was a camping spot by the sea in Egypt, where God led the Israelites just before He rescued them from Pharaoh's army.

moments.title: Camp by the sea
moments.text: The LORD told Moses to turn the Israelites back and camp at Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea. He said He would harden Pharaoh's heart so Pharaoh would chase them, and the Egyptians would know that He is the LORD.

moments.title: Pharaoh catches up
moments.text: Pharaoh changed his mind and chased Israel with his chariots and army. He overtook them camped by the sea near Pi-hahiroth. The Israelites were terrified and cried out to the LORD.

moments.title: The LORD will fight
moments.text: The people feared they would die in the wilderness. Moses told them not to be afraid, to stand firm, and to see the LORD's salvation. The LORD would fight for them.

moments.title: A stop on the journey
moments.text: Israel's travel list says they left Etham, turned back to Pi-hahiroth, and camped near Migdol. From there they set out and crossed through the sea.
